player_prompt.intro: Umdlali {player_id} ku-Connect Four. Isithonjana sediski yakho: {symbol}. Ibhodi lomdlalo linemigqa {num_rows} namakholomu {num_cols}. Abadlali bayashintshana belahla idiski yabo kwelinye lamakholomu (0 kuya ku {end_col}). Owokuqala ukuxhumanisa (ezakhe) amadiski amane ngokuvundlile, ngokuvundlile, noma ngokuxande uyawina. Ngesikhathi sakho, faka inombolo yekholomu kubakaki abakwele ukwenza isinyathelo sakho. Isibonelo: '[col 4]' noma '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali {player_id}, Ifomethi yesenzo engekho emthethweni. Ifomethi elindelekile: "[col x]".
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} ingaphandle kwemingcele.
invalid_move.already_full: Umdlali {player_id}, Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Ikholomu {col} igcwele.
